title: Write a prescription
summary: From the record: Create → Prescription. Template, diagnosis and medications with dose, frequency and duration.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Prescription
steps.details: Opens Instructions → Prescriptions and the prescription form.

steps.title: Template
steps.details: Loads the usual medications and instructions.

steps.title: Practitioner
steps.details: Required: who signs the prescription. If you signed in as a practitioner it is already set.

steps.title: Save the prescription
steps.details: Then you can print it from the prescriptions list.
